name: Anaheim Police Explorer Post
what_you_do: Learn about police jobs at weekly meetings with guest speakers. Help officers at parades, races and big events. Give station tours and help with child safety fingerprinting. Go to a 4 day Explorer Academy.
who_can_apply: Students ages 14 to 21. The page also says you must be a current 7th to 12th grade student. Keep a 2.0 GPA or higher and good attendance. You must never have been arrested and must not use drugs. You must be able to run and do push-ups and sit-ups.
pay_detail: Unpaid. The department pays for most of the uniform. You buy a few items, like shoes and a flashlight.
duration: Weekly meetings, Wednesdays 6 to 8:30 p.m., plus at least one 4 day academy
deadline_text: No dates are posted. You can ask to join at any time by email.
how_to_apply: Email Explorers@anaheim.net to say you are interested. Go to 4 meetings in a row as a guest, in business casual clothes. Then fill out an application. You must pass a written test, an interview and a background check.
notes: Meetings are at the Anaheim Police Department. Academies are held twice a year, often at a military base, and are strict, with drills and exercise. Every Explorer must go to at least one. Questions: Youth Engagement Coordinator, 714-765-1928. The city volunteer page links to an old Explorer page that is gone, so use the police site.
